sn36.11:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antam nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn36.11:1.2: Idha mayham bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evam cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn36.11:1.4: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.11:1.7: Yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin ti ||
sn36.11:1.8: kiṃ nu kho etam Bhagavatā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
sn36.11:2.2: tisso imā bhikkhu vedanā vuttā mayā
sn36.11:2.3: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā
sn36.11:2.6: Yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin ti ||
sn36.11:2.7: taṃ kho panetam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaṃ yeva aniccataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ
sn36.11:2.8: Yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin ti ||
sn36.11:2.9: taṃ kho panetam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhārānaṃ yeva khayadhammataṃ
sn36.11:2.14: Yaṃ kiñci vedāyitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin ti || || 5
sn36.11:2.15: Atha kho pana bhikkhu mayā anupubbaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto ||
sn36.11:2.16: pathamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā niruddhā hoti ||
sn36.11:2.17: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti ||
sn36.11:2.18: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti ||
sn36.11:2.19: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti || ||
sn36.11:2.24: Saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti || ||
sn36.11:2.25: Khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo niruddho hoti || doso niruddho hoti || moho niruddho hoti || || 6
sn36.11:2.26: Atha kho bhikkhu mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ vūpasamo akkhāto ||
sn36.11:2.27: pathamaṃ jhānam samāpannassa vācā vūpasantā hoti ||
sn36.11:2.28: dutiyam jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā vūpasantā honti || la ||
sn36.11:2.29: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā cā vūpasantā honti || ||
sn36.11:2.30: Khīnāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo vūpasanto hoti || doso vūpasanto || moho vūpasanto hoti || || 7
sn36.11:2.32: pathamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vācā paṭippassaddhā hoti ||
sn36.11:2.33: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā paṭippassaddhā honti ||
sn36.11:2.34: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti paṭippassaddhā hoti ||
sn36.11:2.35: catutthaṃ jhānam samāpannassa assāsapassāsā paṭippassaddhā honti ||
sn36.11:2.36: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa sañña ca vedanā ca paṭippassaddhā honti || ||
